patronOf.en-US: Bishop and Doctor of the Church

prayerExcerpt.en-US: Grant us that we may so acknowledge your Son as to have life ever more abundantly.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Concedei-nos conhecer vosso Filho de tal modo que tenhamos a vida em plenitude.

meta.face: A vigorous man of about sixty-five with a wide, rectangular face — a strong, flat brow and a broad, square-set jaw under the beard; a broad, straight nose; wide-set grey eyes under bushy, dark-grey brows; flat, broad cheekbones; a firm, wide mouth; short iron-grey hair receding high at the temples with a small tuft left at the front; a thick, ROUNDED beard of iron-grey streaked with dark hair, trimmed to a rounded edge at the collarbone (not white, not long, not pointed); a steady, kindly teacher's gaze toward the viewer.
meta.basis: Dionysius of Fourna's Painter's Manual gives him as an old man with a rounded beard; Russian icons show the pale phelonion and the book. The iron-grey beard and hair keep him apart from the white-bearded bishops (Athanasius, Nicholas).
